preflight: macOS: xcodebuild SimulatorSigned build-for-testing and signing/resource/provenance guards
notes: The shared coordinator retains the exact Feed origin and action across successful authentication for like, report post, open composer, add comment and report comment on Android, Web/Wasm and iOS.
Like continuation records the requested state and avoids toggling an authenticated account away from a state that is already satisfied.
Comment-report confirmation is emitted only after transport success and all pending confirmations remain available until consumed.
Cancellation, logout and rejected-session transitions clear pending continuations so stale actions cannot execute under a later identity.
No backend fixture or remote mutation was required for this focal preflight. GitHub final jobs retain responsibility for clean-runner integrated certification.
Official, Communities and actions outside the five listed Feed paths remain separate inventory scope.
